summary: The page maintains a clean, readable layout matching the design system specifications, with minor polish needed for reaction placement, code wrapping, and text truncation.

issues.title: Detached reaction placement
issues.description: Reaction component appears disconnected from its parent message bubble.
issues.evidence: The eye reaction icon sits isolated at the far bottom-left below right-aligned message bubbles.
issues.suggestion: Position the reaction directly beneath or anchored to its associated message bubble.

issues.title: Unformatted code wrapping
issues.description: Diff rows wrap code abruptly across multiple lines, impacting readability.
issues.evidence: Lines 13 and 14 break code expressions across two lines without indent continuation.
issues.suggestion: Enable horizontal scrolling or preserve indentation on wrapped diff rows.

issues.title: File metadata truncation
issues.description: File details text truncates prematurely with irregular punctuation.
issues.evidence: Metadata under the file card displays 'TypeScript · 1....'.
issues.suggestion: Allocate adequate horizontal space or format file size strings to avoid awkward truncation.
